The City of Kittitas is required to update this plan by June 30, 2026. Over the summer the City will review potential policy changes. The community is welcome to reach out at any time for questions or updates or attend a public meeting. Final policy changes are expected to be available for public review in fall 2025 with in-person engagement opportunities.

In summer 2025, the city will review community feedback, and look at possible revisions to the Comprehensive Plan, consistent with recent changes to state law. Options will be reviewed with the City Council and Planning Commission at their public meetings.

Final policy changes are expected to be available for public review in fall 2025.
